name: Error Digest
query:
SELECT
	COALESCE(NULLIF(method, ''), '(no method)')  AS "Reason:Data:400",
	SUM(creation >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)    AS "24h:Int:70",
	SUM(creation >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)      AS "7d:Int:70",
	COUNT(*)                                     AS "Retained:Int:90",
	SUM(seen = 0)                                AS "Unseen:Int:80",
	MAX(creation)                                AS "Last seen:Datetime:170"
FROM `tabError Log`
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY SUM(creation >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) DESC, COUNT(*) DESC, MAX(creation) DESC
